purpose: Remove full-period treatment calibration and internal random early-stopping validation, not identify exogenous causality.
known_history: All historical results and the preprocessing issue have already been inspected.
rerun_branch: Full observation window through 2026-08-31. The original outcome-free every-fifth-date/hash sample and network definitions are rebuilt. Six folds are regenerated by the original initial-40%-plus-six-block algorithm; their dates and past calibration endpoint follow that algorithm, not the prior calendar. Gates, families, models and seeds are unchanged.
outer_folds: Six expanding-time folds generated by original 40% initial training plus six equal remaining date blocks; all outcome training labels mature strictly before test start.
fixed_calibration: Per lens/exposure, only signal dates strictly before 2020-10-22. p01/p99 remove outside values (not winsorize); date-center; fixed past SD. Need >=1000 finite rows and >=20 dates. Never move S start or borrow future.
new_preprocessing: Numeric nonfinite -> NaN, native missing handling. Industry vocabulary only from actual fit rows; unseen test categories -> NaN. Same-date dose centering retained as a contemporaneously observable cross-section.
new_models: Exactly old fixed hyperparameters, but early_stopping=False and max_iter=80. Same seeds and deterministic training-row caps.
legacy_control: Re-execute global-dose/industry-dictionary/early-stopping preprocessing on the same expanded panel as a named procedural sensitivity. Differences from older archived estimates also reflect the longer window and regenerated fold dates; they are not a value-by-value reproduction test.
families: Original per lens/exposure-group DML24 and per lens AIPW32; deferred p=1 working values and blank formal inference. No global144/96 claim.
gates: Original >=10000 rows and >=100 test dates and every fold estimated; AIPW >=1000 each train/test group and pooled clip fraction<=0.20; e clipped [.05,.95].
inference: Original date-cluster HAC lag=max(1,ceil(H/5)); normal two-sided p; Holm primary, BH explicitly secondary, 8H Bonferroni per-exposure intervals. Not bootstrap.
paired_comparison: Descriptive only on identical finite stock-date intersections for both modes. Re-express legacy DML dose residual in fixed past-SD units before comparing. Report common rows/dates; never mechanically subtract different-support original table coefficients.
scope_limits: Original source attention construction and controls extended through cutoff. Some controls postdate attention observation; industry historical PIT and exogeneity unverified; no claim of total causal effect or prospective validation.
